meanings.note: Marks many specific human direct objects without a separate English word; in poco a poco it belongs to the expression little by little.

examples.trans: Can you check that socket for me?

meanings.note: Unstressed direct object; can refer to a statement or idea rather than a masculine physical object.
Also links tratar de + infinitive and forms more than with más de; these uses do not express possession.

examples.text: Llevo más de dos años aquí.
examples.trans: I've been here for more than two years.

meanings.note: Auxiliary before a past participle; does not express possession.
The impersonal present is hay, not ha.

examples.text: Tiene muy claro lo que quiere.
